Chapter 6477: Come Catch Me

Chapter 6477: Come Catch Me

“Here I come.” Li Qiye smiled while rubbing his fist.

The lord of Paragon didn’t expect Li Qiye to be serious. He staggered backward and said: “Are you serious?”

“It’s a rare chance, can’t miss it.” Li Qiye said.

“Bastard. Gotta go!” He grumbled before turning into a golden light, disappearing into the deepest part of Paragon.

Paragon shrank afterward, including the part that had invaded Gold Village. The hole in the sky disappeared after being mended by golden power.

Everyone else was left astounded after seeing the lord’s escape.

Was he strong? Of course, he was unbeatable in Paragon. The powerful primal ancestors in the real world stood no chance against him regardless of what they used.

Alas, this being was still scared of Li Qiye?

“Unbelievable.” Alch-deer smiled wryly.

“We have a similar lord, right?” Luosha Emperor asked.

Although Alch-deer was the lord in name, they predicted there might be a dream lord for Gold Village. However, they had never seen this person.

“Again?” Li Qiye chuckled and rubbed his nose.

Taking the lord out of his dream wasn’t easy outside of just destroying everything. The same thing happened with the middle-aged man in Gold Village.

Li Qiye could destroy all three dreams but the souls might be severely damaged, leaving behind a slow-witted man.

“Boom!” Suddenly, a third power of the eternal affinity emerged and swept over the dream realms.

Those in smaller dreams were swept out of it, feeling horrified and confused.

“Paragon!” Alch-deer and the others became alarmed.

Li Qiye turned around and glanced at the source of the dream - Paramount. The power of eternity allowed the dreams to continue and spread across Sea of Heaven Sin.

“Rumble!” Paramount changed entirely, seemingly being uprooted into the air. The plains became chaotic and stars appeared out of nowhere.

At the very center, the source of Paramount became visible. Its lord could also be seen, looking like a spirit. A river of longevity floated around it, inviting other cultivators to come.

North Kun God, Tenacious, Seventy-two Origin Ancestor, Trinity, Whale, and many others arrived.

Getting close to this spirit required jumping into the river and facing the temporal force. They weren’t confident while watching the various visual phenomena unfolding before their eyes.

“Buzz.” North Kun God started splitting the moment he stepped into the river. Different versions of him appeared nearby.

Under normal circumstances, a cultivator splitting into copies was not an issue. However, this was splitting his souls, spirits, dao, vitality, and everything else. The severance could be permanent.

Thus, he roared and stabilized his dao heart, bringing back all the versions while resisting the temporal effect.

Seventy-two Origin Ancestor faced the same problem. His wings draped down defensively, making him look like a bright chicken.

The three brothers known as Trinity fused and split continuously, unable to maintain a proper independence.

“Come, come catch me!” Meanwhile, the spirit at the source happily danced in the air, provoking all of them.
